description: This source file contains utility functions for handling ninja build commands related to precompiled headers, including generating filenames for PCH files, writing compiler flags, and managing PCH output files within the build system.

methods.name: GetPCHLangSuffixForToolType
methods.description: Returns the language-specific suffix for precompiled header files based on the tool type.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHFile
methods.description: Computes the filename for the Windows precompiled header (.pch) for a given target and tool.

methods.name: WriteOneFlag
methods.description: Writes compiler flags for a target, handling precompiled headers and substitutions.

methods.name: GetPCHOutputFiles
methods.description: Determines the output files for precompiled headers based on the target and tool.

methods.name: GetGCCPCHOutputExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension for GCC precompiled header output files.

methods.name: GetWindowsPCHObjectExtension
methods.description: Returns the object file extension for Windows PCH files, annotated with language type.
